(()=>{var Z=.5*(Math.sqrt(5)-1),S=1e30,d=16;function G(f,e,t,l,x,o){if(f===0)return 0;if(f===1)return e-Math.sqrt(Math.max(e*e-o*o,0));if(f===2){let a=Math.max(o-(e-t),0);return H=A,g=T,q=g-Z*(g-H),D=H+Z*(g-H),w=m-q*h,b=c-q*p,v=t+q*y+G(a,r,s,n,i,Math.sqrt(w*w+b*b));w=m-D*h,b=c-D*p;let I=t+D*y+G(a,r,s,n,i,Math.sqrt(w*w+b*b));for(let j=0;j<30&&!(g-H<1e-9);j++)v<I?(g=D,D=q,I=v,q=g-Z*(g-H),w=m-q*h,b=c-q*p,v=t+q*y+G(a,r,s,n,i,Math.sqrt(w*w+b*b))):(H=q,q=D,v=I,D=H+Z*(g-H),w=m-D*h,b=c-D*p,I=t+D*y+G(a,r,s,n,i,Math.sqrt(w*w+b*b)));let N=Math.min(v,I);for(let j of[A,T,O]){w=m-j*h,b=c-j*p;let B=t+j*y+G(a,r,s,n,i,Math.sqrt(w*w+b*b));B<N&&(N=B)}return N}function ot(f){let e=new Float64Array(160).fill(0);for(let t=0;t<32;t++)e[t*5]=-1;for(let t of Object.keys(f)){let l=+t,x=f[t].row;for(let o=0;o<5;o++)e[l*5+o]=x[o]}return e}function rt(f,e){let{x0:t,y0:l,res:x,nx:o,ny:a}=f,r=new _=class{constructor(e,t,l){this.g=e,this.nx=e.nx,this.ny=e.ny,this.H0=rt(e,t),this.H=this.H0.slice(),this.own=new dirty(){return this.di1>=this.di0}load(e,t){this.H.set(e),this.own.set(t),this.recomputeBlocks(0,this.bny-1,0,this.bnx-1),this.markAllDirty()}reset(){this.load(this.H0,new s=x;for(;s<o;s++){r&&r(s);let n=s*3;if(f.apply(e[n],e[n+1],e[n+2],t[n],t[n+1],t[n+2],l[s]&31),(s&31)===31&&a&&performance.now()>a){s++;break}}return s}function ht(f,e,t,l,x,o,a,r){let s=-1/0,n=1/0;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){let M=e[i]+f[i][0]*x+f[i][1]*o,u=f[i][2];if(Math.abs(u)<1e-12){if(M<t[i]||M>l[i])return r}else{let
